nom: Avène Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser Lotion

avis.texte: I washed my face once with this and it caused a really intense allergic reaction. There is a coconut derivative in it which is allegedly a very common irritant. Not sure why brands put these ingredients in skincare

I tried a new face serum which destroyed my skin, leaving it red and stinging. I needed something more soothing so I tried this cleanser. It felt like i was rubbing in lotion and didnt feel clean when i tissued it off. I ended up rinsing if off. It left a film but skin felt hydrated. To remove makeup, i found that if i used a wet soft washcloth to remove , it would take off my light makeup. My face started to heal and was less oily. Unfortunately after a week i noticed closed comedones popping up. Probably from the residue left on my skin despite rinsing well. It was hydrating for me but also very comedogenic as well. So on to search for another gentle cleanser.
This is the only face wash I've been able to find that doesn't irritate my sensitive eczema skin. It also soothes my face when it's irritated. This stuff is amazing!
This is the only face wash that smoothes and doesn't irritate my sensitive eczema face.

I have serious cystic acne (only held in check by rounds of medication every 10 years or so), as well as eczema and dryness. I'm very fair with some freckles and a tendency towards irritation. I use the avene cleanser lotion as step #2 of a two-step cleanse, with DHC oil as step #1. As I wear sunscreen every day and make-up often, I don't think I could use it alone. But the two are so gentle and yet effective together. They've been my face cleansers for roughly 3 years now, and while my skin is by no means perfect (and likely never will be) its not enraged and uncomfortable either.

avis.titre: I've been using for a few years now.
avis.texte: I use this every night to wash my face. It's gentle on my skin and removes makeup. Before use, I do use an eye make up remover and then wash. Also have used it on airplane's or camping because you don't have to rinse it off. I usually do rinse at home though.

avis.titre: The only thing that didnt make my face burn
avis.texte: I'm pretty sure that i damaged my skin barrier completely by constantly trying new skin care products ugh... It got to the point that it looked like i had hives all over my face from how irritated my skin got after cleansing with my usual daily cleanser. I switched out to the sensitive cleansers from cetaphil to cerave and neither worked even vanicream that is said to be for extremely sensitive skin burned. Then i was recommended this one and it really is the only thing that helped my skin T_T It is light enough to not irritate my face but also leaves it quite soft after using i would definitely recommend. Now i just need to find a good moisturizer... I have combination skin btw but now its leaning more to dry

avis.titre: Perfect for sensitive skin and prevent pimples
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and kept having pimples. Went to a pharmacy in France and the pharmacist told me: don't use water, you have a sensitive skin! Buy this. Never looked back in 10 years! I have no more pimples and my skin is perfect- still sensitive!

This is the best face cleanser I've used!! I bought the hypersensitive kit and this was my favorite product in it! I have very sensitive redness-prone skin and this cleanser seems to even calm down my redness. It doesn't dry out skin at all and sometimes I don't even feel like using moisturizer after using it because my skin feels SO nice and hydrated. I will say it doesn't clean makeup off that well but I easily use micellar water before this cleanser and this product removes any remnants, plus provides that extra hydration after cleansing off makeup. my facial redness has improved a lot because i simplified my routine to just this and occasionally xeracalm moisturizer. also it lasts a LONG time - a little goes a long way! the itty bitty bottle from the kit lasted me like 3 months :)
I've been having a hard time with my skin drying out after washing it. I felt like moisturizer getting past the 1st layer of skin. After using this cleanser my skin is so soft and renewed!

I bought this today at the store and i got it because it say it is extremely gentle and for sensitive reactive skin. But when i washed my face with it, my skin was all red everywhere..i was very surprised! I wouldn't recommend if you are really sensitive or have sensitive skin! But that is just my experience with this.

Love this. It took me a couple uses to adjust to it, as I've never used a cleanser like it before. It's like a thin lotion. I dampen my face before using it, and I do use a damp cloth to gently wipe off what remains after washing my face. My skin is clean *and* moisturized after using, which is awesome, and I haven't needed as much other products afterward to restore and protect my skin barrier like I would with other face washes that make my skin tight, dry, flaky, and itchy after using them. I have very sensitive and reactive skin, it dries out very easily. This wash is lovely. It does not claim to be a makeup remover, so I wouldn't expect it to remove heavy eye makeup or foundation very easily. But I almost never wear make up on my skin, and I use an eye makeup remover, specifically, for that. Also, this product is fragrance free which is essential for sensitive and reactive skin. I almost sent it back after the first use, I'm glad I figured out to apply to a damp face, because I really love it.

I have been suffering from rosacea since mid November. This is new for me. My dermatologist said the flare up could be due to the change of climate between Maryland and Denver. We visit our grandkids in Colorado every 6 weeks. I continue to have problems using your product even though I had been prescribed antibiotic and steroid creme. If my face would settle down, I would love your product it felt great fgoing on.

This is the best face cleanser I have found for sensitive and eczema-prone skin. It removes my water soluble mascara and other makeup easily and leaves my face and neck feeling soft and supple, never dry, taut or irritated.

This is not a cleaner I would expect to take make up off. As someone who didn't wear any makeup due to eczema breakouts this is perfect to cleanse and remove oil. My face feels clean and it helps with the eczema. Great product!

It's perfect for refreshing my skin when it doesn't need a wash. I use it often in the morning. It leaves my skin looking dewing, feeling clean and moisturized, and sets a great barrier for the day. Highly recommend a try if you have sensitive or dry skin!

avis.titre: SECOND STEP in a 2-step Cleansing Routine
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser for 2-3 years, but as the SECOND step in a 2-step cleansing routine. It wouldn't be enough to take off makeup and sunscreen. I start with DHC deep cleansing oil (rubbed on a dry face, as per the instructions) and then after I rinse that off in the shower I use the Avene extremely gentle cleaner as the second cleanse. I also use it in the mornings when I wake up, as many dermatologists recommend that those with sensitive skin only splash their face with water in the morning or use something as profoundly gentle as this cleanser is. I find it very useful and imagine I'll continue to use it indefinitely. Again, it's not appropriate after an entire day out and about with sunscreen and/or make up on.

I reacted to my skincare routine with burning, itching, and dry bumps. I ordered Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser as a first step in remedying the issue. Only a small amount is required and I rinse it off. I also used the Avene Cicalfate + Cream afterward. My skin is now hydrated and the symptoms are gone. I will continue using this cleanser.
Have extremely sensitive skin. Not sure if it was this or the cream

avis.titre: Please bring back the cleansing cream
avis.texte: Stings and burns terribly within seconds of using fingers to gently apply the cleanser. I could leave the old cream formula in the tube on while I was in the bath even and it would soak right in and never once caused me any irritation and improved my outdoor work exposed skin.
Wonderfully silky on my face and doesn't irritate my rosacea. I love this company as it has completely changed the appearance and feel of my face. Bye bye rosacea!
This cleanser is best for my skin. Please try to keep it in stock.

I wish I loved it. I had a cool peel and I was glad that I still had tolerance extreme cream cleanser it was so soothing This was tolerable but not soothing it took more wiping of my sensitive skin to get off
Very gentle on my skin, cleans well. Very happy with this product.
So gentle and soothing, I use it on dry skin and rinse. My skin loves it! Highly recommend!!

Agree with reviews that say this is extremely gentle but doesn't clean effectively. For the couple of weeks I used the Avene cleanser, I had visibly clogged pores and buildup in areas that usually would not be problem areas. Reccomend in the instance that you're dealing with a rash or irritation on the face. But this didn't personally work as an overall everyday cleanser
This is a great cleanser for anybody who has irritated or sensitive skin. It is truly universal to any skin type.

I have had acne most of my life, and literally everything I have tried including other products from the dermatologist that have caused redness, irritation, sensitivity and breakouts. I began using Avene Xeracalm products about 4 years ago, and still used them every day for the body, however, Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser has revolutionized my facial skin. I use it exclusively, and it feels wonderful, does not create sensitivity nor redness, and has settled my occasional breakouts down to just a few per month. I am thrilled and highly recommend it.

I am not sure why the description says it will remove makeup. I have used the Replenishing Oil Cleanser for years and I love it.please restock it!! My face feels so fresh after. I can use micellar water after and the pad is clean. With this it's like I never cleaned my face. I love ALL of my Avene products but this was a complete waste.
The absolute best. I was the biggest fan of the tolerance extreme line and this product was a saving grace while switching over. Can't imagine my routine without it now!

I wanted this to work, since id heard great things aboht avene. Unfortunately i just couldnt get this to remove any makeup. I finallg realized this when using it to remove makeup off the back of my hand and despite much rubbing nothing came off. Super bummed

Extremely gentle! Works really well in combination with the micellar water to double cleanse. It is more on the liquid side so I wish it had a bit more texture but it feels light and gentle and easy to remove with water.
Using this cleanser for many years. Very gentle, I remove makeup from eyes as well with no irritation. And it's also hypoallergenic.
Great cleanser for sensitive skin. Cleans skin well and doesn't dry it out.

avis.titre: Good, but not for my skin
avis.texte: This cleanser I have used for a year and a half, and it cleanses the easy surface areas on your face very well without stripping the skin. Like forehead, cheeks, etc. But it does not do well cleaning the harder areas even when double cleansing, like the nose. My nose personally clogs up a lot because I am very oily and have many blackheads, but if thats not a problem for you I say you would like this product. (Also there is no fragrance lol)

avis.titre: Good, but not for my skin
avis.texte: This cleanser I have used for a year and a half, and it cleanses the easy surface areas on your face very well without stripping the skin. Like forehead, cheeks, etc. But it does not do well cleaning the harder areas even when double cleansing, like the nose. My nose personally clogs up a lot because I am very oily and have many blackheads, but if thats not a problem for you I say you would like this product. (Also there is no fragrance lol)

I have highly reactive, dry, aging and sun damaged skin with rosacea like flushing and pustules plaguing me. Dermatologist recommended this and it changed my skin almost immediately! Love Avene products! Now I use several in my routine and it has truly been life changing! I'm not embarrassed of my face anymore. Thank you Avene!
Disappointed that it does not remove my makeup. It's fine as a second cleansing product once the face is free of eye and face make up.
Less than a pea sized amount of this super gentle cleanser gets the job done. Never drying or irritating. My skin always looks hydrated and clean, never tight or red.
I'm enjoining the gentleness of this cleanser. I choose to rinse it off in the shower and pat dry.
Pleasant, soft, creamy serum that doesn't irritate my skin and cleans well.
Gentle yet effective. I love using this in the morning. Leaves skin hydrated. Love it.

I like using this cleanser to remove my sunscreen and make up. I then remove with Cotton pads. I do this twice to be sure all of the sunscreen, etc has been removed. Then I wash my face with a gentle cleanser that rinses off with water. I have mature dehydrated skin that is prone to acne. Avene cleanser does not cause any breakouts or irritation. I am very pleased with it.

avis.titre: Love all Avene products I use
avis.texte: Avene is the only brand that keeps my highly sensitive and rosacea red skin completely beautiful and under control. People constantly ask me what I do to keep my skin so beautiful and to look so young. Thank you, Avene!

The old avene tolerance extreme lotion was a million times better. But the discontinued it and suggested this instead so I purchased it hoping for a similar product. What I got was a product that is horrible at removing makeup and not only doesn't hydrate my skin but instead makes it feel more dry after using it. Definitely don't recommend.

My skin was going through a hyper sensitive and reactive period. I was itchy and red and had no idea why. I tried the tolerance line just so I could add any form of moisture to my skin without irritating it. This cleanser is SO soothing. It won't remove makeup but it'll leave your skin calm, soft and not one bit irritated. This cleanser just makes me feel safe. It is a very safe pick for those who need a calming solution. I love that I can rise it off or wipe it off. Your choice.
Love this gentle cleanser for my very sensitive facial skin. It doesn't upset my rosacea at all. Highly recommend.
The cleanser really does calm my skin. I was recently diagnosed with Seborrheic dermatitis & it is the only thing that does not sting when cleansing my skin.

I bought this product back in 2021 recommended by a store associate when they told me my skin barrier was most likely damaged. My skin started healing and stopped breaking out within a couple of weeks. Highly recommend to anyone w/ sensitive skin
Works great and is so gentle. My skin is eczema prone and most cleansers are too harsh. Leaves my face clean, but not feeling tight.

It's similar to Kheil's gentle cleanser, which is now discontinued. I was searching for something similar and this is very similar. I have very sensitive skin, and I get bumps with most products, but this product makes my skin look amazing.
I have had eczema since I was a baby and i have tried almost every single clenser out there that claimed to be gentle on the skin. Let me tell you, eczema guys and gals, look no further.
This is the best cleanser I have ever used! I have sensitive skin and psoriasis this is amazing! It leaves my skin with a beautiful glow and is so gentle! Would recommend!

If "gentle" cleansers aren't gentle enough for you, this is IT. It's in the name - extremely gentle. My combo, acne-prone, reactive and sensitive skin can attest. The thin, lotion-like consistency will throw some people off and would not be a foaming cleanser person's cup of tea, but it's the only cleanser I've found that truly cleans gently. All the big name gentle cleansers have been stripping enough and not replenishing enough to compete. I use it as my only cleanser with light to no makeup, and as a second cleanse after an oil-based cleanser if I wear foundation. Micellar water to take off my mascara, before.
This cleanser has been wonderful for my crazy sensitive skin. This cleanser along with the thermal spring spray has helped calm my skin. Avene please make this in a larger bottle!

I was using the Tolerance Extreme Cleansing Lotion, which was amazing, but they have discontinued it. So they recommended that I try this product and it really irritated my skin. I felt burning / itching and then soon after I had small red patches all over my face. It felt like it really dried out my skin. I really wanted to like this product. I'm super disappointed because this is not a comparable product to the Tolerance Cleansing Lotion at all!

avis.titre: Great for removing makeup, breakout free!!
avis.texte: I bought this abroad on a recommendation from my French BFF, and it is amazing for removing eye makeup! I can't use oil cleansers because they break me out, but this cleanser has a similar texture and breaks down makeup just as well. I personally would only use this when i double cleanse, I can't imagine it doing a whole lot of cleansing by itself.

This is great to have on hand for morning cleansing. I don't understand how it works without rinsing it off (and sometimes I still do), but cleans well and gently. Not the best for removing makeup, but perfect for a fresh morning face.

My skin is extremely reactive lately. I am acne-prone and my dermatologist has me on a benzoyl peroxide/clindamycin topical in the morning and a tretinoin topical at night. This combination (particularly in the mornings) can cause a lot of stinging, burning, itching, and discomfort after cleansing and applying the topical, and that's before I apply my moisturizer. I have to use moisturizer due to the drying nature of the medications, and I absolutely must use sunscreen. The problem has been that IT HURTS! I've only used this cleanser twice so far, once last night prior to my tretinoin, and once this morning prior to my bzp/clin topical. So far, I am IN LOVE! The morning medication didn't burn and make me want to rip my skin off. The real moment of truth was the moisturizer, though. I'm using the tolerance balm and I was prepared for my usual extreme discomfort, but guess what? NOTHING! It doesn't burn, itch, sting, or hurt. My face feels moisturized and comfortable. I am so thrilled I found this skincare line by total accident. I love my Cetaphil, but even that hasn't cut it with these topical medications. Maybe now I'll actually keep up on the daily routine with my topicals since I don't have to choose between painful, clearer skin and a face riddled with breakouts.

I have extremely sensitive skin and this was great. Didn't turn me red nor give me dermatitis as some harsher products do. I wish the Extreme Tolerence Hydrating Crème was in stock becasue I would like to try that too.
Gentle cleanser. Seems a lot like Cetaphil. Absolutely does not remove makeup.
Calmed my face and doesn't dry it out. Also helps with my rosacea.
Too watery… need to use on a damp wash cloth so it doesn't run down your hand. Not worth the money.
This product is just OK. I have used several cleansers over the years and will not purchase this in the future.

I have very sensitive skin that is also dealing with acne. Usually, I get dried out when I wash my face but then massively break out if I don't, so I tried this since it is gentle and no-rinse. So far my face likes it for the sensitivity and its way less drying. I am still getting some breakouts but not as bad. I also don't turn bright red or burn when I use it, so that's super nice. give it a 4 because it's a keeper but I am also not like 'OMG MY FACE IS AMAZING!' To me that would be a 5. :) I wish there were more instructions on the bottle, though. I am unsure if I'm supposed to wipe away the cream to clean or just massage it in and leave it to clean? I've been doing both with equal results, just wish I had a bit more info on the bottle.
Great non-irritating cleanser for hypersensitive skin issues. I do use a wash cloth to remove it in the evenings only because I like that wiped clean feeling. (If that makes sense)
I have many skin allergies and cannot use regular soap. I am able to use this product without any side effects. Love it.
This is my go to cleanser! My super reactive skin loves it. Even at its worse this one has no sting.
This is a gentle way to cleanse your skin when it's irritated. Makes me Don feel soft.
So gentle on my skin & I love that I can use it with or without water.

avis.titre: True to the claim, great cleanser
avis.texte: I have dry skin and although I don't struggle with sensitivity, most cleansers tend to leave my skin super dry and tight. This one does not! It cleans my face And I don't feel like my skin was stripped. I love how simple and to-the-point this cleanser is. Definitely recommend!

I bought this to use as a makeup remover. However, my skin still feels irritated after makeup is wiped off. I tried to wipe my face as gently as I could but that did not help. I have gone back to using natural plant oils to remove makeup. I am now using this cleanser in the morning instead and that is okay.

avis.titre: My favorite cleanser I've ever tried
avis.texte: This was by far the most gentle yet effective cleansers I have ever tried. I was so bummed when I ran out I do look to purchase this on my own. It left my skin feeling hydrated plump and overall refreshed!
Never leaves my skin feeling dry! I use a wet wash cloth to remove the cleanser. Leaves my skin feeling so clean.

As someone with sensitive skin, I'm always looking for a good gentle cleanser. I've tried Avene's products before and was excited to try this new step for my routine. The cleanser is definitely gentle, so much so you barely feel it on your skin. It doesn't create much of a lather and you don't get that clean feeling you do with harsher cleansers, but that's not necessarily a bad thing. My main complaint is the texture of the cleanser. It's a bit watery, comes out of the bottle more quickly than expected and it's hard to figure out how much you need. I can see this getting used up quickly, which at its price point will get expensive.

I use this in combination with an oil/balm cleanser (TO squalane cleanser)to get a really effective and gentle double cleanse. What I like about this product is I can either use it as a first or second cleanse. As a first cleanse, I use it with a cotton round and wipe away makeup and sunscreen with it. As a second cleanse, I just use It with my hands and rinse it with water even if that's not how its meant to be used but it rinses off really well regardless! Don't want to be without this.

I found this cleanser at a time when my skin was having an abnormally horrible reaction to something. It was red and irritated, almost like a bad sunburn and nothing I tried helped, until I tried this cleanser. This cleanser honestly made a world of difference, it cleans without striping your skin of moisture or irritation. I paired it with Avene moisturizer and my skin was able to heal and get back to normal quicker than I could even hope for. I think it works for pretty much any type of skin you have! It's the perfect gentle yet effective cleanser I've found. I highly recommend, especially to people that have sensitive skin!
I'm glad I got to try out this sample. I'll definitely purchase this one and try some other Avene products!

avis.titre: It is very gentle but does not remove makeup
avis.texte: It does not remove very sheer powder nor sunscreen so It is kinda useless to me. I usually just wear sunscreen and loose powder. I dont even use any makeup( foundation etc) yet this failed to remove it
It was way too harsh for my skin and I ended up with redness and irritation. I'm going to ask for a refund as I optimistically bought two!
I was pleasantly surprised when I tried this cleanser. My skin can be sensitive at times and I find it responds well to gentle cleansers. I really liked how this felt on my skin overall!
This cleaner very gentle on the skin. Effective at removing dirt and makeup and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. The smell is neutral and not offensive. Didn't break me out.
Pros: no scent, feels nice Cons: my skin felt extremely dry after use

This cleanser is very gentle on the skin. Fragrance free. Absolutely no irritation. My skin is very dry and this gentle cleanser absorbed quickly on my skin. I used a dime size amount on my face and applied in a circular motion. It rinsed off easily. The cleanser left my skin softer. I recommend this cleanser for sensitive skin and all other skin types.

I liked that this was gentle on my skin and didn't make my face feel tight or stripped of moisture after using. However, I don't think it did many favors for my skin type, which is not only sensitive but also oily/combination and acne prone. I didn't feel like I got a good "deep down clean" that I was looking for, almost like it was too gentle on the dirt as well. Overall I enjoyed it but won't be my #1 pick in my bathroom.

To be honest I have a personal preference with facial cleansing and how anything should lather if it is to clean, that being said I didn't much like this cleanser for the fact it didn't lather at all. It does deliver in the gentle part and it never dried out my skin or left it feeling dirty. I would definitely recommend to anyone who doesn't have the "lather" hangup that I do. My skin even felt much better because of it but the no lathering bothers me a bit.

I liked the product just fine but was not blown away. I have very sensitive skin so was impressed with the subtle fragrance and the product did feel gentle on my skin. However, I've used better gentle cleansers in the past and would not swap it out for the one I currently use. Perfectly fine but not my favorite.
I was at first a little disappointed that it took awhile to receive a sample size, I also thought it would be a larger item. This feels greasy and doesn't really make your face feel clean.
This cleanser is so gentle, moisturizing and works well. I have dry skin and have tried so many that promise to hydrate my skin and don't. This one does. It leaves my face feeling amazing
I have dry/relatively sensitive skin and this cleanser does not irritate it at all. It removes makeup effectively and cleanses gently.

This cleanser is just what it says it is.. GENTLE. I love that it is scent free and washes off so easily! I feel so clean when I use it and can tell when I've forgotten! I will definitely be adding this to my daily regimen.

I have used Avene products now for several years. I first tried their thermal water spray years ago and fell in love with their line of products, so I was pretty excited to try this out as well. I'm a little hesitant to try new cleaners because many dry me out and leave me red and irritated, but this gentle cleanser is exactly what it claims to be; gentle. Not only did my face feel clean and refreshed after using but it didn't strip my face dry. No irritation or dryness after. I would recommend this cleanser especially for those who want to stay balanced yet feel clean.
Lovely feel, gentle yet powerful cleanser, nice scent. Interested in purchasing.

This cleanser made my skin feel clean but still healthy and moisturized and not tight. It also didn't irritate my psoriasis. I took away one star only because I give 5 stars only to my HG products, and I still prefer Goat Milk Cleanser to this one. But if you are looking for a new cleanser and you love Avene, you will not go wrong.
I have temperamental, sensitive skin. This product worked wonderfully for me. I highly recommend it.

I am really happy that I got a chance to try Tolerance by Avene, it truly is an extremely gentle cleanser for the face, eyes and lips. I had a 25 ml sample size bottle that I used twice daily for over that past month now and it has helped with my hypersensitive skin. I often get redness when my skin is irritated or prior to an acne breakout and Tolerance has helped in soothing and calming the areas most affected. The best part is that you do not have to rinse it off, you just wipe off any excess product, if any. Tolerance has a milky lotion texture that quickly absorbs into the skin and really does restore the skins barrier from dryness. My face has never felt so calm and soothed. I will absolutely be buying and using again and would highly recommend to others.

My skin is dry and sensitive. It was dehydrated too. I destroyed my skin barrier by overloading it with too many products. The 10 step Korean skin care routine did not work for me. I had to go back to basics. I couldn't even put bottled artisan water on my skin; it burned. That's how bad it was. I tried other products for sensitive skin before I tried this, and now I've found my holy grail. Within days I noticed every single patch of damaged and dry skin was gone. Keep in mind I used this in conjunction with the Avene thermal water. I would clean my face with this, then spray the water as a toner, pat it in and use a gentle baby lotion as a moisturizer. I did it twice a day. My skin has never looked better. I haven't had one pimple since I started using this. I went through a mild, EXTREMELY mild purge where I saw one or two pimples that quickly disappeared. After that, not one breakout. A little goes a long way so this bottle should last me a while. I'm not gonna buy another cleanser ever. T

Loved this cleanser for my fair and sensitive skin. It was extremely gentle but took off makeup and left a clean feeling. It did not make my face feel dry. Compared to other gentle cleansers I've tried, this is my favorite by far because I actually feel like my skin is clean. I highly recommend using this product!

I enjoyed my sample of Avène Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser. I find Avène products to be very high quality and suitable for my super sensitive, rosacea plagued skin and this cleanser is no different. I like that it worked to clean thoroughly, but didn't leave my skin feeling too dry or too oily, which is an issue with some hydrating cleansers. I'm really careful about what I use on my face because it's so angry a lot of the time and I'm happy to find a new cleanser to add to my routine.

avis.titre: High quality cleanser with great results
avis.texte: This is one of the best cleansers I've ever used! It is very smooth and a nice consistency. It's easy to apply and a little goes a long way. I used this product twice a day and noticed a difference almost immediately. My skin is smoother, more balanced, and more hydrated. I will continue to use this product when my sample runs out.
I was excited to try a new cleanser I am in the market for one. I didn't like the consistency of this one it feels to runny for my liking. The smell was good and not too much. I was hoping for more.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that made my skin SO soft!
avis.texte: I am absolutely in love with this facial cleanser. The fact that you can use it with or without water is a winner for me, and just how soft and hydrated it made my skin feel after I was done is a major bonus! I'm not going to lie, I had to look this stuff up online and get translated instructions on how to use it, but it was so worth it. I would definitely buy this for myself! Love it so much and will be sad when my sample is gone!!

When I first received product, it came with no instructions or application technique. Most of the bottle is written in French so I had to use Google to search the product and how to use it. It has a decent smell and felt nice to the touch. Using a cotton pad I applied product as per Google directions and surprisingly it didn't feel sticky after it dried. Do Not Wash Off. It's meant to stay on your skin. I would recommend purchase due to the convenience of the average on the go woman who would benefit from this product.
I got a small sample size and it was okay, didn't break me out so that was good. Feels like a nice gentle cleanser.
This cleanser is extremely mild, but does a great job completely cleansing my skin without stripping it
Avene never disappoints! This cleanser left my skin feeling very soft and supple. I love how smooth it made my face feel!

My skin can be very finicky when it comes to cleansers. I do not tolerate fragrances and preservatives such as methylisothiazolinone. I can go a couple of days but, more often than not, I end up getting bumps on my face. I was very pleased with my experience trying Avène Tolerance. It cleansed without striping my skin and after a week and a half, no angry bumps! It was a bit more liquid than I expected so, admittedly I did lose a bit of wash on my first try as I wasn't anticipating it to pour out so quickly but, the consistency did not hinder it's efficacy. The only issue I could perceive is that it may not break down heavy eye make up as well but, I usually use make up wipes before washing on days where my look is more bold. This was is a great staple for maintaining a healthy complexion!
Extremely gentle on my sensitive skin. Was able to use it without it causing my face to become very red and irritated

this was an interesting cleanser -- I've never really used a cleanser that you didn't wash off after and because of that, I wasn't sure if my face really felt clean. I tried to maintain an open mind, but it made me wonder what was happening to the things that this no-rinse cleanser was cleaning if I wasn't rinsing it off -- was it just continuing to sit on my face or go deeper into it? I was also put off a bit after I used it-- it felt a bit sticky, however after a few minutes it seemed to have been absorbed and my face did feel a bit soft (though I was still worried about how clean it was). It was great to try but I don't think this is for me.
Avène Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser brightens and tones my complexion . My skin is soft and clear because of this brand. I truly love it.

avis.titre: Gentle moisturizer for all skin types!
avis.texte: I am pleasantly surprised with how lightweight this moisturizer is, yet it is extremely soothing on my dry skin! It also does an amazing job at reducing any redness in my face. I really like that is has virtually no scent at all which is a nice change for once. In my opinion this gentle cream is perfect for all skin types! I will definitely recommend this product to friends and family.
I received a little sample so not much to review but the little I did get came a long way. It was gentle on my face and smells good.

It is truly a super gentle cleanser. I didn't irritate my skin, and didn't leave my skin feeling dry. I like that I can use it multiple times a day (2x) and didn't feel my skin super dry. I didn't give it 5 stars because the sample provided didn't give me enough to try for at 3 weeks, which is when I notice real results from products
This face wash was gentle on my sensitive skin. It didn't make my skin dry and felt nice and light. My skin felt so clean and removed all the dirt and oil from the day. Good to use everyday.

I have extremely dry skin so I'm careful about what I use. This product first of all had almost NO smell. I couldn't smell it in the bottle and could only kind of smell it once applied. I love that. It is MUCH gentler than the product I've been using for 10 years and it has really helped me maintain a skincare routine. It is very soft and almost feels more like a lotion than a cleanser, that's how smooth the texture is. I would absolutely recommend this to friends, especially someone with sensitive skin.
I really enjoyed using this cleanser! It did leave my skin feeling clean and refreshed without a film like some cleansers I know. I would purchase this!

This product was nice to try. Very gentle. Not suds. Not scented but did have an interesting naturally occurring smell to it. While it was non irritating I did think it wasn't very hydrating. Definitely back this up with a moisturizer and you'll be good.

So I had to say I've never used a waterless face wash before, so I started as I always would with wiping my face down with a wet washcloth. I did have to go to the website to get the instructions as I couldn't find any on the actual bottle itself, that being said, once I figured out how to use it, I proceeded. I applied it, and it feels just like described, a lotion. I guess I let it sit on long enough b/c I had none left to wipe with a cotton pad. I've been using Dove for the past little bit, but this gave my skin a similar feeling, but less tightness. Even as a lotion, I still needed a moisturizer, which is normal. It has zero scent, and overall is easy to use and didn't cause any irritation on my skin initially. I did notice about an hour later I did feel a little bit of irritation, but I can't pinpoint that to the cleanser or if it was the moisturizer. I'll continue playing around with this cleanser and different moisturizers to see what the effects are. Overall it's a great product, especially for dry sensitive allergy prone skin.

I have had no issues with my sensitive skin while using this cleanser. I don't wear a lot of makeup, only mascara occasionally so I don't know how well it takes face makeup off but it did make my face feel incredibly clean.

avis.titre: Extremely Gentle is exactly what it is
avis.texte: Super gentle, no real scent. This didn't dry out my skin like some other "gentle" cleansers do.
